title: Input Layer
body:
[[Input]]

---

The data going in, one unit per feature. It is not really a layer: it has no [[Weights]], no
[[Bias Term]], and no [[Activation Function]], and it computes nothing. It is the input
[[Vector]] drawn as a row of circles. On [[MNIST]] it is 784 units, one per pixel of a
$28 \times 28$ image flattened out.

Counting convention: a "two-layer network" usually means two layers *with weights*, so the input
layer is not counted. See [[Hidden Layer]] and [[Output Layer]].
